## Change

What changes, and why? Identify the affected contract or operator behavior.

## Verification

Commands/scenarios, source revision and actual PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL results.
Distinguish tests using fictitious data from real-account checks.

## Not verified

List remaining assumptions and target-environment checks.

## Review checks

- [ ] No credentials, real access URLs, customer captures or initialized state.
- [ ] Any EAI calls, production changes or data deletion were agreed in advance.
- [ ] Minute rules, scope and explicit unknown policies are preserved or reviewed.
- [ ] Licence notices remain intact; any runtime redistribution is approved.
- [ ] Documentation and inventories match this change.
